name: Cupbearer
overview: The role of the cupbearer in Scripture is shown as a position of significant trust and responsibility, as seen in Genesis where Pharaoh's cup was carefully prepared and handed over by his chief cupbearer. This office involved close proximity to the king, symbolizing both honor and accountability. Nehemiah also identifies himself as the king's cupbearer, highlighting the spiritual dimension of his service as he prayed for favor and mercy while fulfilling this important role.
